priority_blocker_addressed.claim: Godot production runtime needs real input + save/state lifecycle
priority_blocker_addressed.finding: Prior 'ACTUAL_PRODUCTION_RUNTIME' evidence (gate1/tools/core_loop_runner.py) was a Python mirror of GameManager, never the Godot engine. Existing tests/*.gd smokes run via `godot --script`, which does not load project autoloads at all, so any gameplay script that touches an autoload (ItemManager, InputProfileCatalog, CrashWatchdog, ...) fails to compile under them while the smoke still prints PASS (confirmed reproduced: DigitalRcProductStateTest.gd and AlphaProductStateTest.gd both swallow real SCRIPT ERROR / Compilation failed output and exit 0).
priority_blocker_addressed.fix: Added scripts/rc/ProductionGateHarness.gd, a new autoload that only activates behind `-- --production-gate`, boots the real MainMenu.tscn main scene with every autoload live (identical to a shipped build), and drives it with the real Input singleton (Input.action_press/parse_input_event on actual InputMap actions) rather than GameManager.accept_test_mode autopilot.
priority_blocker_addressed.real_defect_found_and_fixed: The harness caught a genuine input bug on its first run: RaceScene._unhandled_input and PauseMenu._unhandled_input both listen for the 'pause' action, and Godot still delivers one input event to every listening node in the same flush regardless of a paused-state mutation mid-flush. A second real pause-key tap while already paused double-toggled (menu closed then immediately reopened), so keyboard/gamepad/touch players had no way to resume other than a mouse click on the Resume button. Fixed with get_viewport().set_input_as_handled() in both listeners so only one toggles per physical tap. Verified via the harness before/after.

known_gap_not_fixed_this_cycle.issue: tests/AlphaProductStateTest.gd and tests/DigitalRcProductStateTest.gd run via `godot --script`, which never loads autoloads, so scripts referencing them (ItemManager.gd, InputProfileCatalog.gd, CrashWatchdog.gd) fail to compile inside those two smokes specifically, yet both smokes print PASS/exit 0 regardless because GDScript runtime errors do not raise catchable exceptions and neither harness treats stderr output as a failure signal.
known_gap_not_fixed_this_cycle.why_not_blocking: ProductionGateHarness.gd (this cycle's addition) boots the real main scene with autoloads live and is the authoritative ACTUAL_PRODUCTION_RUNTIME evidence; it does not share this blind spot.
known_gap_not_fixed_this_cycle.recommendation: A future pass should either delete the two affected `--script` smokes (superseded by the production harness) or teach them to manually instantiate autoload-dependent nodes the way tests/G2C6RuntimeTest.gd already does.
